features.title: Per-project donate button with progress tracker
features.description: Each temple card should have a 'Donate to this project' button with a live progress bar showing amount raised vs goal
features.notes: Currently no direct per-project donate flow exists. Users must leave site entirely.

features.title: Social proof near donation CTAs
features.description: Add small stats like '10,000+ brick donors worldwide' or recent donor activity feed near Donate buttons
features.notes: Trust signals near CTAs significantly improve conversion in donation contexts.

features.title: Email capture / newsletter signup
features.description: Add a lightweight email capture form (name + email) for construction updates newsletter
features.notes: No email capture exists currently. Missing opportunity to re-engage visitors.

features.title: Recurring donation option
features.description: Add monthly/yearly recurring donation option instead of one-time only
features.notes: Recurring donors provide predictable revenue for construction timelines.

features.title: Search and filter on temples list
features.description: Add search bar and filters (by region, status, completion %) on the /temples page
features.notes: As project count grows, users need a way to quickly find specific temples.

features.title: Construction timeline/milestones visualization
features.description: Add a visual timeline on temple detail pages showing milestones achieved and upcoming
features.notes: Milestones API exists (/temples/:id/milestones) but no frontend visualization.

features.title: Mobile-optimized temple detail page
features.description: Temple detail pages need responsive optimization — image galleries, progress bars, and CTAs should adapt to mobile
features.notes: Mobile is likely 60%+ of traffic for donation-focused sites.

features.title: Share project on social media
features.description: Add share buttons (WhatsApp, X, Facebook) to temple detail and landing pages
features.notes: Viral sharing is key for religious/community donation campaigns.

features.title: Donation receipt / tax certificate
features.description: After donation, generate a downloadable receipt with temple name, amount, date for tax purposes
features.notes: Tax receipts are a strong motivator for larger donations.

features.title: Accessibility audit and WCAG compliance
features.description: Run a full accessibility pass — alt texts, keyboard navigation, ARIA labels, color contrast checks
features.notes: Several ARIA labels missing in nav. Shloka text may have low contrast.
